SELECT t.fromorderno AS order_no,t.cust_code AS customer_code,t.source_flag AS source_kind,t.executeorderno AS execute_no,t.material_code AS sku,t.needbillingdate AS need_billing_at,t.pickup_point AS pickup_point,t.track_status AS source_stage,t.peidan_status AS prepare_status,t.paiche_status AS dispatch_status,t.zhuangche_status AS loading_status,t.zaitu_status AS transit_status,COUNT(*) AS source_rows,CASE WHEN COUNT(*)=1 THEN MAX(t.after_inventory_short_qty) END AS after_inventory_short_qty,CASE WHEN COUNT(*)=1 THEN MAX(t.final_short_qty) END AS final_short_qty FROM agents_scm_shortage_trace_f t INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT e.cust_order_no,e.cust_code FROM agents_scm_execute_detail_d e WHERE e.header_addtime >= :gea_p1 AND e.header_addtime < :gea_p2 AND (:gea_p3 IS NULL OR e.belong_base = :gea_p3) AND (:gea_p4 IS NULL OR e.region_name = :gea_p4) AND (:gea_p5 IS NULL OR e.province_region_name = :gea_p5) AND (:gea_p6 IS NULL OR e.sales_group_name = :gea_p6) AND (:gea_p7 IS NULL OR e.cust_type = :gea_p7) AND (:gea_p8 IS NULL OR (e.cust_code = :gea_p8 OR e.cust_name LIKE CONCAT('%',:gea_p8,'%'))) AND (:gea_p9 IS NULL OR e.cust_order_no = :gea_p9) AND (:gea_p10 IS NULL OR e.material_code = :gea_p10) AND (:gea_p11 IS NULL OR e.logistics_provider = :gea_p11)) scope ON scope.cust_order_no=t.fromorderno AND scope.cust_code=t.cust_code WHERE (:gea_p10 IS NULL OR t.material_code = :gea_p10) GROUP BY t.fromorderno,t.cust_code,t.source_flag,t.executeorderno,t.material_code,t.needbillingdate,t.pickup_point,t.track_status,t.peidan_status,t.paiche_status,t.zhuangche_status,t.zaitu_status ORDER BY t.fromorderno,t.cust_code,t.source_flag,t.executeorderno,t.material_code,t.needbillingdate,t.pickup_point,t.track_status,t.peidan_status,t.paiche_status,t.zhuangche_status,t.zaitu_status LIMIT :gea_p12 OFFSET :gea_p13

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total FROM (SELECT t.fromorderno,t.cust_code,t.source_flag,t.executeorderno,t.material_code,t.needbillingdate,t.pickup_point,t.track_status,t.peidan_status,t.paiche_status,t.zhuangche_status,t.zaitu_status FROM agents_scm_shortage_trace_f t INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT e.cust_order_no,e.cust_code FROM agents_scm_execute_detail_d e WHERE e.header_addtime >= :gea_p1 AND e.header_addtime < :gea_p2 AND (:gea_p3 IS NULL OR e.belong_base = :gea_p3) AND (:gea_p4 IS NULL OR e.region_name = :gea_p4) AND (:gea_p5 IS NULL OR e.province_region_name = :gea_p5) AND (:gea_p6 IS NULL OR e.sales_group_name = :gea_p6) AND (:gea_p7 IS NULL OR e.cust_type = :gea_p7) AND (:gea_p8 IS NULL OR (e.cust_code = :gea_p8 OR e.cust_name LIKE CONCAT('%',:gea_p8,'%'))) AND (:gea_p9 IS NULL OR e.cust_order_no = :gea_p9) AND (:gea_p10 IS NULL OR e.material_code = :gea_p10) AND (:gea_p11 IS NULL OR e.logistics_provider = :gea_p11)) scope ON scope.cust_order_no=t.fromorderno AND scope.cust_code=t.cust_code WHERE (:gea_p10 IS NULL OR t.material_code = :gea_p10) GROUP BY t.fromorderno,t.cust_code,t.source_flag,t.executeorderno,t.material_code,t.needbillingdate,t.pickup_point,t.track_status,t.peidan_status,t.paiche_status,t.zhuangche_status,t.zaitu_status) g

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT t.fromorderno) AS matched_orders,COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN (t.peidan_status LIKE '%超时%' OR t.paiche_status LIKE '%超时%' OR t.zhuangche_status LIKE '%超时%' OR t.zaitu_status LIKE '%超时%' OR t.track_status LIKE '%超时%') THEN t.fromorderno END) AS overdue_orders,COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN (t.peidan_status LIKE '%预警%' OR t.paiche_status LIKE '%预警%' OR t.zhuangche_status LIKE '%预警%' OR t.zaitu_status LIKE '%预警%' OR t.track_status LIKE '%预警%') THEN t.fromorderno END) AS warning_orders,COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN t.peidan_status LIKE '%超时%' THEN t.fromorderno END) AS allocation_overdue,COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN t.peidan_status LIKE '%预警%' THEN t.fromorderno END) AS allocation_warning,COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN t.paiche_status LIKE '%超时%' THEN t.fromorderno END) AS dispatch_overdue,COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN t.paiche_status LIKE '%预警%' THEN t.fromorderno END) AS dispatch_warning,COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN t.zhuangche_status LIKE '%超时%' THEN t.fromorderno END) AS loading_overdue,COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN t.zhuangche_status LIKE '%预警%' THEN t.fromorderno END) AS loading_warning,COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN t.zaitu_status LIKE '%超时%' THEN t.fromorderno END) AS transit_overdue,COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN t.zaitu_status LIKE '%预警%' THEN t.fromorderno END) AS transit_warning FROM agents_scm_shortage_trace_f t INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT e.cust_order_no,e.cust_code FROM agents_scm_execute_detail_d e WHERE e.header_addtime >= :gea_p1 AND e.header_addtime < :gea_p2 AND (:gea_p3 IS NULL OR e.belong_base = :gea_p3) AND (:gea_p4 IS NULL OR e.region_name = :gea_p4) AND (:gea_p5 IS NULL OR e.province_region_name = :gea_p5) AND (:gea_p6 IS NULL OR e.sales_group_name = :gea_p6) AND (:gea_p7 IS NULL OR e.cust_type = :gea_p7) AND (:gea_p8 IS NULL OR (e.cust_code = :gea_p8 OR e.cust_name LIKE CONCAT('%',:gea_p8,'%'))) AND (:gea_p9 IS NULL OR e.cust_order_no = :gea_p9) AND (:gea_p10 IS NULL OR e.material_code = :gea_p10) AND (:gea_p11 IS NULL OR e.logistics_provider = :gea_p11)) scope ON scope.cust_order_no=t.fromorderno AND scope.cust_code=t.cust_code WHERE t.source_flag='履约追踪' AND (:gea_p10 IS NULL OR t.material_code = :gea_p10)

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total FROM (SELECT e.cust_order_no,e.cust_code,e.belong_base,e.logistics_provider,e.waybill_no,e.waybill_status FROM agents_scm_execute_detail_d e WHERE e.header_addtime >= :gea_p1 AND e.header_addtime < :gea_p2 AND (:gea_p3 IS NULL OR e.belong_base = :gea_p3) AND (:gea_p4 IS NULL OR e.region_name = :gea_p4) AND (:gea_p5 IS NULL OR e.province_region_name = :gea_p5) AND (:gea_p6 IS NULL OR e.sales_group_name = :gea_p6) AND (:gea_p7 IS NULL OR e.cust_type = :gea_p7) AND (:gea_p8 IS NULL OR (e.cust_code = :gea_p8 OR e.cust_name LIKE CONCAT('%',:gea_p8,'%'))) AND (:gea_p9 IS NULL OR e.cust_order_no = :gea_p9) AND (:gea_p10 IS NULL OR e.material_code = :gea_p10) AND (:gea_p11 IS NULL OR e.logistics_provider = :gea_p11) GROUP BY e.cust_order_no,e.cust_code,e.belong_base,e.logistics_provider,e.waybill_no,e.waybill_status) g

SELECT s.belong_base AS base,s.material_code AS sku,MAX(s.material_name) AS material_name,s.the_date AS stock_date,COUNT(*) AS source_rows,CASE WHEN COUNT(*)=1 THEN MAX(s.current_stock) END AS stock_qty,CASE WHEN COUNT(*)=1 THEN MAX(s.available_stock) END AS available_qty,CASE WHEN COUNT(*)=1 THEN MAX(s.current_stock_60) END AS over60_source_qty,CASE WHEN COUNT(*)=1 THEN MAX(s.produce_plan) END AS production_plan,CASE WHEN COUNT(*)=1 THEN MAX(s.produce_in_qty) END AS production_in_qty,CASE WHEN COUNT(*)=1 THEN MAX(s.product_item) END AS product_item,CASE WHEN COUNT(*)=1 THEN MAX(s.series) END AS series,CASE WHEN COUNT(*)=1 THEN MAX(s.main_sales_plan_v1) END AS main_plan_initial,CASE WHEN COUNT(*)=1 THEN MAX(s.bp_sales_plan_v1) END AS bp_plan_initial,CASE WHEN COUNT(*)=1 THEN MAX(s.main_sales_plan_adj) END AS main_plan_adjusted,CASE WHEN COUNT(*)=1 THEN MAX(s.bp_sales_plan_adj) END AS bp_plan_adjusted,CASE WHEN COUNT(*)=1 THEN MAX(s.transfer_out_plan_v1) END AS transfer_plan_initial,CASE WHEN COUNT(*)=1 THEN MAX(s.transfer_out_plan_adj) END AS transfer_plan_adjusted,CASE WHEN COUNT(*)=1 THEN MAX(s.next_month_sales_plan) END AS next_month_sales_plan,CASE WHEN COUNT(*)=1 THEN MAX(s.next_month_out_plan) END AS next_month_out_plan,CASE WHEN COUNT(*)=1 THEN MAX(s.day_count_of_month) END AS month_days,MAX(d.product_tag) AS product_tag,MAX(g.transfer_tag) AS transfer_tag FROM agents_scm_stock_detail_d s INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT e.belong_base,e.material_code FROM agents_scm_execute_detail_d e WHERE e.header_addtime >= :gea_p1 AND e.header_addtime < :gea_p2 AND (:gea_p3 IS NULL OR e.belong_base = :gea_p3) AND (:gea_p4 IS NULL OR e.region_name = :gea_p4) AND (:gea_p5 IS NULL OR e.province_region_name = :gea_p5) AND (:gea_p6 IS NULL OR e.sales_group_name = :gea_p6) AND (:gea_p7 IS NULL OR e.cust_type = :gea_p7) AND (:gea_p8 IS NULL OR (e.cust_code = :gea_p8 OR e.cust_name LIKE CONCAT('%',:gea_p8,'%'))) AND (:gea_p9 IS NULL OR e.cust_order_no = :gea_p9) AND (:gea_p10 IS NULL OR e.material_code = :gea_p10) AND (:gea_p11 IS NULL OR e.logistics_provider = :gea_p11)) scope ON scope.belong_base=s.belong_base AND scope.material_code=s.material_code LEFT JOIN (SELECT material_code,CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT NULLIF(responsible_item,''))=1 THEN MAX(NULLIF(responsible_item,'')) END AS product_tag FROM agents_dim_product_list_mi GROUP BY material_code) d ON d.material_code=s.material_code LEFT JOIN (SELECT stat_period,target_base,material_code,CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT NULLIF(transfer_tag,''))=1 THEN MAX(NULLIF(transfer_tag,'')) END AS transfer_tag FROM agents_dim_transfer_direction_mi GROUP BY stat_period,target_base,material_code) g ON g.material_code=s.material_code AND g.target_base=s.belong_base AND g.stat_period=SUBSTRING(s.the_date,1,7) WHERE s.the_date=(SELECT MAX(s2.the_date) FROM agents_scm_stock_detail_d s2 WHERE s2.the_date<:gea_p2) GROUP BY sourceGaps.metric: 未开订单数 / 未开满足率
sourceGaps.reason: 有效明细状态10、纳统标志1与备单状态=备单中确定待备订单；占单量换算为CS箱，完整需求按来源单行去重。需求冲突、未知换算或重复执行键不使用部分结果代替整体满足率。
sourceGaps.reasonEn: Preparing counts use detail status 10, statistical inclusion 1 and explicit preparation state. Allocation is converted to CS boxes and demand is deduplicated by source line. Conflicting demand, unknown conversion and duplicate execution keys do not produce partial overall fulfillment rates.

sourceGaps.reason: 已接明细有效性、虚拟/短拨标记；调账、安全库存、内部订单、人工排除及KA需求取值仍未完整确认，同源单同SKU重复需求不能相加。
sourceGaps.reasonEn: Validity and virtual/short-transfer flags are available; remaining exclusions and KA demand selection are not fully confirmed. Repeated demand cannot be summed.

sourceGaps.reason: 已接来源单、执行单、作废时间及客户改单时间；全部O接收订单分母、锁定期与有效提报量仍待确认，改单严重阈值存在方向冲突。
sourceGaps.reasonEn: Source/execution identities and cancellation/change timestamps are available; full received-order denominators, lock periods and valid submitted demand remain unconfirmed. Severity thresholds conflict.

sourceGaps.reason: 已有is_ontime源标记，但缺当期应交付时间、承诺时间、GPS/人工到货依据及12小时容差版本；不能用完成样本代替应交付订单分母。
sourceGaps.reasonEn: The source flag lacks due-delivery denominators, promise/GPS timestamps and the applicable 12-hour tolerance version. Completed samples cannot stand in for orders due.

sourceGaps.metric: 终缺 / 当天及之前 / 未来5日累计终缺
sourceGaps.reason: 已通过当前授权执行单与SKU关联缺货供应匹配记录，汇总唯一源键的final_short_qty并发布覆盖；重复键或未关联记录不补零。源快照与完整分配账本未确认，暂不重算时间窗及供应分配。
sourceGaps.metricEn: Final shortage / current and five-day windows
sourceGaps.reasonEn: Unique source final_short_qty facts are joined through authorized execution orders and SKUs with explicit coverage. Duplicates and unmatched records are not filled with zero. Snapshot and allocation ledger remain unconfirmed; time windows and supply allocations are not recomputed.

sourceGaps.reason: 已在品项原列按10日初版、20日纠偏、月末下月初版计算；缺计划、非指定快照、零分母、重复源键保持未知，分页行不冒充整体均值。
sourceGaps.reasonEn: Computed per SKU using the documented snapshot plan versions. Missing plans, non-designated snapshots, zero denominators and duplicate keys remain unknown; paginated rows do not establish an overall average.

sourceGaps.metric: 未来5日排产 / 调拨 / OEM / 货龄分箱
